description: Change the mode of each FILE to MODE.

option.name: --changes
tip: like verbose but report only when a change is made

option.name: --dereference
tip: affect the referent of each symbolic link (this is the default), rather than the symbolic link itself

option.name: --no-dereference
tip: affect symbolic links instead of any referenced file (useful only on systems that can change the ownership of a symlink)

option.name: --reference
tip: use RFILE's mode instead of MODE values

option.name: --verbose
tip: output a diagnostic for every file processed

option.name: -H
tip: if a command line argument is a symbolic link to a directory, traverse it

option.name: -L
tip: traverse every symbolic link to a directory encountered

option.name: -P
tip: do not traverse any symbolic links (default)
